name: Wrist 5-axis AB head 0.4 nozzle
printer_notes: Wrist: an AB belt gimbal on an A1-class bed-slinger (docs/nonplanar/kinematics/wrist). B tilts a frame about machine Y (outer, +-80 deg), A tilts the hotend about the frame's X (inner, +-68 deg); both axes meet 44 mm above the nozzle tip (rotary_tool_length). Joint speed caps: A 690 deg/s, B 540 deg/s, the motors at 1,000 rpm through the 8.6:1 and 11:1 belt reductions. Joint-space XYZAB G-code with G93 inverse-time feed; the slicer does the tool-centre-point compensation (rotary_firmware_rtcp = 0). Linear limits are the A1-class donor's; the Z travel is the stock 256 mm less the 50 mm the wrist hangs lower. Head envelope 'wrist' from the design's geometry.json; uncalibrated.
